# Road Rule
哔哩哔哩: https://space.bilibili.com/3546726445091690 QQ: 760057820
## Feature
Restrict vehicles based on Car Flags, Size Class, Energy Types, and Vehicle Type. You can prevent specific vehicles from using certain roads or lanes.
## Support
If you find this mod helpful, please consider giving it a star !
## Contribution
Please check on GitHub.
## Comments
It is recommended to report issues on Github first, followed by the Paradox Forum.
Github > Paradox Forum > Other
Wherever you report an issue, please make sure to describe it clearly.
* When reporting a bug, please provide as much detailed text description / game save files / screenshots / logs, or any other relevant information that can help identify the issue.
* When requesting a feature, please provide as much detailed text description / images, or anything else that can help clarify your request.
